name: crm-new-company-dialog
title: New company dialog
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Dialog form with a logo upload, identity, relationship, and commercial sections, and field validation.

meta.descriptionEs: Formulario en un diálogo con logo, secciones y validación.

examples.title: Alta
examples.description: Nombre, estado, responsable y valor son obligatorios.

meta.usage:
<CrmNewCompanyDialog
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  statuses={statuses}
  owners={owners}
  onSubmit={(draft) => addCompany(draft)}
/>

api.name: statuses / owners
api.description: Options for the two required choices. Values are ids.

api.name: onSubmit
api.description: Called only when companyDraftIssues() is empty. Includes logoUrl when a file was accepted.

api.name: labels.issues
api.description: Replace the English validation sentences. Codes stay stable.

docs: Clean-room behavior inspired by github.com/kargulstudio/sales-crm, which publishes no license. No source, class names, colors, copy, or assets were copied. Validation lives in companyDraftIssues(). A logo must be PNG, JPEG, WebP, or GIF and at most 2 MB. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite avatar, button, dialog, input, label, select, or textarea. The item ships no theme. Errors use aria-invalid and move focus to the first invalid field. Required names are marked in the label.
